name: Le Thai Tong temple festival
nameVi: Lễ hội đền thờ vua Lê Thái Tông
summary: Incense and offerings at the temple and the Quế Lâm stele in town, then drum, dance, a food contest, and folk games. One page prints 15–17 of the first lunar month. Another prints 15–17 in the header and 22–24 in the body, and says the first city edition fell on 15–17 of the first lunar month in 2016. The 2027 civil dates are check on arrival. The fee is check on arrival.
when: 15–17 or 22–24 of the first lunar month. The 2027 dates are check on arrival.
